# CIC vs phase-space-sheet density PDFs (generated by analyze_sheet.py)

Same DiscoDJNative z = 0 snapshots (study-1 ICs) for both estimators; 256³ analysis mesh; top-hat R_s; volume weighting = cells equally, mass weighting = each cell by its deposited mass.

R_s = 0 denotes the raw 1.17 Mpc/h cells (no smoothing, no window deconvolution), a diagnostic outside the study-1 set R_s = 7–42 Mpc/h.
